title: The public render caches a sanitized document body per page version
detail: The render cache holds up to 500 entries keyed on tenant, slug, language, version and format. Bodies larger than 256 KB are sanitized on every render and not cached.

title: A managed page body is Markdown or an editor document, edited in the document editor
detail: The page entity has a new field bodyFormat ("markdown" or "document", default markdown). Pages and events from before the field read as markdown and render unchanged. A document body is HTML from the template-resolver document editor; page create, update and managed-pages:write:set check it with sanitizeDocumentHtml and store the rebuilt HTML and answer a rejected body with field errors on body (i18n key managed-pages.errors.document.rejected, new in all locale packages). The public render sanitizes a document body again and serves an empty body, with a logged warning, when a stored one fails. managed-pages:write:set takes an optional bodyFormat; omitting it sets markdown, it does not preserve the stored format. The page-edit screen no longer has a body textarea: its body section is the extension section managed-pages:page-body (PAGE_BODY_EXTENSION_NAME), which opens a Markdown body converted to HTML, shows a warning for what the conversion drops (images, block quotes, code, headings below level 3, relative links) and writes body and bodyFormat "document" only after the first edit. The ETag of the public page includes bodyFormat. seedPage takes an optional bodyFormat and throws on a rejected document body.
migration: Run `kumiko-schema generate` and apply the migration; read_pages gets a bodyFormat column with default 'markdown', no rebuild is needed. Mount `managedPagesClient()` from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/managed-pages/web` in createKumikoApp({ clientFeatures }); without it the body section of page-edit shows the missing-component placeholder. Apps that replaced page-edit with their own screen keep the textarea and send no bodyFormat, so their pages stay markdown.

title: MANAGED_PAGES_FEATURE names the feature
detail: The barrel exports the MANAGED_PAGES_FEATURE constant so other code can refer to the feature name without a string literal.

title: Branding screen edits the logo file and readBranding returns logoFile
detail: The branding settings screen has a logo upload for managed-pages:config:branding-logo-file, and readBranding and the branding query include logoFile next to logoUrl. The template resource errors template_resource_too_large and template_resource_unsupported_image have German and Spanish texts.

title: A rate-limited page request answers 429 with Retry-After instead of 503 or an unbranded page
detail:
Managed pages and sitemap answer 429 when rate limited, agent catalog checks the deny list, draft cleanup continues past skipped rows
A rate-limited managed-page request now answers 429 with `Retry-After` instead of 503 or an unbranded page, and `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt` answer 429 instead of silently dropping the managed-page entries. `buildToolCatalog` throws when its manifest was built with `denyQns` that the catalog options lack. The form-draft cleanup no longer stops when a whole batch was re-saved by users in the meantime.

title: Anonymous queries rate-limit per IP and handler instead of sharing one bucket
`managed-pages`' `GET {basePath}/:slug` render route and `seo`'s `sitemap.xml`/`llms.txt`…
detail: `managed-pages`' `GET {basePath}/:slug` render route and `seo`'s `sitemap.xml`/`llms.txt` routes now use the `systemQuery` in-process dispatch (introduced for `legal-pages` in the `resolverTrust` fix) instead of an internal `app.fetch` self-request with a forged `X-Tenant` header. That self-fetch carried no `Host` header (Host is only implied by the request URL, never stored in `Headers`), so a host-based `anonymousAccess.tenantResolver` reading only the header resolved `null` for the inner request. Under `resolverTrust: "authoritative"` there is no client-tenant fallback for a `null` resolution, so the route failed with `tenant_required` (503 "page unavailable" / empty sitemap entries) even for a legitimate, correctly-routed visitor. `systemQuery` forces the already host-resolved tenant in-process — no header round-trip, nothing that can go missing. Consumers running `managed-pages` or `seo` with `resolverTrust: "authoritative"` should upgrade — the render/discovery routes were not reliably servable under that mode before this fix. - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework@0.147.3 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dispatcher-live@0.147.3 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless@0.147.3 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer@0.147.3 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web@0.147.3

title: managed-pages: add a `./managed-pages/web` client export (`managedPagesClient()`) so apps…
detail: managed-pages: add a `./managed-pages/web` client export (`managedPagesClient()`) so apps can register the feature's admin-screen translations into the browser i18n store. Previously the server-side `r.translations` bundle never reached the client, so configEdit/entityEdit labels (branding, page CMS) rendered as raw i18n keys in the admin UI. The client bundle is pivoted from the same `MANAGED_PAGES_I18N` source (no key duplication). renderer-web: extract a shared `FormScreenShell` primitive — the canonical centered `max-w-3xl` form/settings column that `DefaultForm` (configEdit/entityEdit) already used. Exporting it lets custom settings screens share the exact same width + centering instead of each author re-inventing the wrapper. `user-data-rights`' privacy-center screen adopts it. - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web@0.123.1 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework@0.123.1 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dispatcher-live@0.123.1 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless@0.123.1 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer@0.123.1

title: managed-pages: ship de/en translations for its admin screens (branding settings + page CM…
detail: managed-pages: ship de/en translations for its admin screens (branding settings + page CMS) via `r.translations`, so field labels, section headers and screen titles no longer render as raw i18n keys. Any app mounting `managed-pages` now boots with a complete, translated admin surface. Also adds `tag` and `key` to the nav-icon allowlist (`NAV_ICONS`) so nav entries using those keys render a Lucide icon instead of the grey dot fallback. - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web@0.122.5 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework@0.122.5 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dispatcher-live@0.122.5 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless@0.122.5 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer@0.122.5
